newsitem.title: HUNGARY: EBRD launches turnaround project for Hungary firms.
newsitem.headline: EBRD launches turnaround project for Hungary firms.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) said Friday it had set up a 30 million Ecu facility to finance the rstructuring of viable under-performing medium-sized Hungarian companies.

The project, the Hungarian Special Restructuring Programme, is to be managed by Sandtmer Hamilton and Management GmbH, a firm based in Germany specialising in industrial turnarounds, the EBRD said in a statement.

The programme will provide higher-risk equity finance, hands-on turnaround management expertise, technical cooperation and a framework to promote debt and operational restructuring, Sven Hergstad Director of EBRD's Early Stage Equity team said.
"Underperforming companies will be given a chance to achieve turnaround and sustainable profitability," he said.
Up to 30 million Ecu of equity finance will be invested in a portfolio of 10 to 15 Hungarian economies during the seven-year life of the programme.
The European Union's PHARE programme is supporting the EBRD investment by providing 5.4 million Ecu in technical cooperation funds, the statement said.
